cand.title: GVA Workshop 2027
cand.organizationName: Genève Aéroport / Travel Inside industry event

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified organizer-side relationship candidates: Nicolas Simonin, Responsable développement tourisme/transport at Genève Aéroport, named as an organizer in 2025 and the airport’s published 2026 exhibitor-registration contact; Yves-Daniel Viredaz, Head of Business Development at Genève Aéroport, named as an organizer in 2025 and identified in the 2026 event report as Chef de service Business development. Both are relevant for introductions and establishing whether any lodging requirement exists. Neither is verified as a hotel-contract signatory or housing buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Fifth GVA Workshop announced for 27 May 2027, a single-day edition at Restaurant Le Chef, Genève Aéroport, Geneva, Canton of Geneva, Switzerland. This is the activity date, not the announcement publication date of 12 October 2026. The announcement is from TRAVEL INSIDE, the established event media partner; the airport event page retrieved still describes 4 June 2026. Therefore this is a published upcoming edition, not an inferred annual date, but owner-side 2027 reconfirmation remains outstanding. No 2028 edition announcement was located.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference using the supplied hotel specification and sourced event format: geographic relevance is credible because the event takes place at the airport, but YOTEL Geneva Lake is in Founex, not on-terminal. Its supplied 237-room inventory, six meeting rooms and approximately 250-theatre largest room could accommodate the historical low-hundreds event scale in principle, subject to layout and transport checks. That does not create a displacement opportunity: the workshop and dinner are already announced at Le Chef. The realistic thesis is conditional individual or small exhibitor/organizer lodging and longer-term travel-trade relationships, not a confirmed 20–120-room block, whole-house buyout, resort retreat or downtown-congress housing play. No event-specific transfer arrangement to Founex was found.
findings.venueCommitments: Restaurant Le Chef at Genève Aéroport is the named 2027 venue. The airport describes Le Chef as a restaurant with six flexible private rooms in Terminal 1, public area before security, Restaurant/Terrace level. Geographic classification: Geneva Airport corridor, Canton of Geneva; not Founex/Nyon/La Côte, not downtown Geneva and not Lausanne. The venue is not a hotel. This is a published venue selection, not evidence of a signed contract or any accommodation commitment.
findings.historicalRotation: Verified sequence: 22 June 2023, 6 June 2024, 22 May 2025 and 4 June 2026, all at Restaurant Le Chef, Genève Aéroport. The announced fifth edition returns there on 27 May 2027. No destination or venue rotation is evidenced. Recurrence is supported by numbered editions and dated reports, not merely by assuming annuality.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Unknown. No edition-specific housing bureau, host hotel, room block, accommodation booking link or open hotel RFP was identified in the reviewed announcement, airport event page, exhibitor dossier or accessible registration introduction. No hotels are listed as accommodation partners in these materials. Exact published sourcing pathway for event participation, not lodging: “Please confirm your participation using the registration form and return it by email (nicolas.simonin@gva.ch).” The dossier identifies “GENÈVE AÉROPORT Responsable développement nicolas.simonin@gva.ch”. These quotations establish an organizer/exhibitor channel only; neither establishes hotel purchasing authority. The 2026 registration form exposes only a heading in accessible text, limiting verification. Silence does not mean hotel sourcing is open.
findings.organizationStructure: Genève Aéroport is the event organizer, not a travel-trade association. It describes itself as an autonomous public establishment owned by the State of Geneva. Event reporting attributes delivery to its Marketing/Business Development team. TRAVEL INSIDE is the media partner, not a proven co-owner or accommodation buyer. Restaurant Le Chef is the venue. Eventwise hosts registration pages; this alone does not establish a PCO/DMC mandate. No appointed housing agency or PCO was identified.
findings.competitiveLimitations: The principal incumbent is the airport restaurant, not a competing host hotel. Le Chef offers its own private meeting rooms, catering and terminal location, limiting the reason to move the workshop or dinner. The regional target audience and one-afternoon/evening format suggest limited overnight conversion (inference), reinforced by the 2024 offer of return CFF tickets for agents/travel managers coming from Lausanne and beyond. This is historical transport evidence, not a 2027 rail commitment or proof of zero room demand. No room shortage, denied inventory, overflow or incumbent lodging hotel is evidenced. A hotel employee appearing on a panel is not a room-block commitment.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: Contact Nicolas Simonin first at the airport-published nicolas.simonin@gva.ch; involve Yves-Daniel Viredaz for the broader relationship. Ask whether any 2027 airline representatives or organizers require overnight stays, who selects/pays for them, whether a lodging arrangement already exists, and what arrival/departure dates, room counts and transport conditions apply. Offer a short Founex hotel site visit and a conditional accommodation/transfer discussion only if a need is confirmed. Ask about permitted hotel relationship/sponsorship participation rather than assuming the airline exhibitor package applies. Do not price a block or propose replacing Le Chef without a brief.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the forthcoming 2027 edition, the main meeting/F&B venue is announced elsewhere; do not present it as an open venue sale. Lodging accessibility is unconfirmed, not closed or open. No published 2027 hotel procurement process or hotel-exhibitor eligibility was found. The 2026 exhibitor dossier was airline-specific; its CHF 900 excluding tax package and 27 March 2026 deadline are historical and must not be offered as 2027 hotel participation terms.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: retain as travel-trade relationship development with conditional ancillary lodging, not a qualified room-block lead. Four historical editions and the 2027 announcement show continuity at Le Chef rather than rotation. A later-edition venue pitch is speculative unless the organizer confirms a change or unmet need. No 2028 date, venue competition, lodging RFP or hotel overflow is evidenced.
